crown.method: Manual full-frame census at native resolution and in all four 2x quadrant crops; every visually distinguishable conifer crown, including saplings, overlapping crowns, and edge-clipped crowns, was included, with a 31 source-pixel median scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.
